description: Contains definitions for Dialogflow CX Playbooks, which are used to orchestrate conversational flows and tool usage.

schema.name: runtime
schema.description: The timestamp when the data extraction process was run.

schema.name: run_guid
schema.description: A unique identifier for each execution run of the data extraction process.

schema.name: agent_project_id
schema.description: The Google Cloud project ID of the Dialogflow CX agent.

schema.name: agent_location_id
schema.description: The GCP region or location of the Dialogflow CX agent (e.g., 'us-central1').

schema.name: agent_id
schema.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the Dialogflow CX agent.

schema.name: agent_name
schema.description: The human-readable display name of the Dialogflow CX agent.

schema.name: playbook_id
schema.description: The unique identifier for the Dialogflow CX playbook.

schema.name: playbook_name
schema.description: The human-readable display name of the Dialogflow CX playbook.

schema.name: goal
schema.description: The user-defined goal or objective of the playbook.

schema.name: input_parameter_definitions
schema.description: A JSON string defining the input parameters that the playbook accepts.

schema.name: output_parameter_definitions
schema.description: A JSON string defining the output parameters that the playbook can return.

schema.name: instruction
schema.description: The natural language instruction that guides the execution of the playbook.

schema.name: referenced_flows
schema.description: A list of Dialogflow CX flows that are referenced or can be called by this playbook.

schema.name: referenced_playbooks
schema.description: A list of other Dialogflow CX playbooks that are referenced or can be called by this playbook.

schema.name: referenced_tools
schema.description: A list of Dialogflow CX tools that are referenced or can be used by this playbook.

schema.name: playbook_settings
schema.description: A JSON string containing detailed configuration for the playbook, such as LLM model settings.
